purpose: Non-destructive syllabus mapping of the 38 proposed replacement questions. This file does not authorize insertion, CSV edits, publication, PR merge or production deployment.
source_policy: Checked against the corresponding JAMB IBASS subject PDFs on 1 November 2026. A term not individually named is not automatically out of scope: distinguish an explicit listed topic/objective from a reasonable application of a broad syllabus topic. Items marked provisionally_aligned are not academically approved or cleared for publication. Subject-review-required items remain held pending subject-competent review.
